decision.name: Ransomware encryption: two shapes of one process tree
decision.reasoning: Ransomware encryption (ATT&CK T1486): rewrites of existing files (20 existing files rewritten in 60 s, last /home/u/docs/f19.odt); ciphertext-like content (4 of 4 files beside /home/u/docs/f19.odt high-entropy with no format header) by /home/u/.local/bin/nn-ms-enc (pid 5200003, writer pid 5200003; no package installed it). Two shapes of one actor within 120 s: kill its process tree [enforced by the signed per-rule policy: the kill of the ransomware actor's process tree (NN-L-IMP-001, lab PR 225)]
